<notes>
kept|base harness → no code changes proposed by inv1 or dom1 candidates (both harness.diff show "(no change)"); all three rollouts (base1: 30,2; inv1: 30,1; dom1: 60,1) produced deliverables with no delivery failures; output variance reflects LLM sampling variance on identical harness, not harness defect; prior decision stages (inv1.md, dom1.md) both explicitly concluded KEEP_BASE; mission emphasizes "a defect in 1/1 is noise, and an edit aimed at it is overfitting to one sample" and "the costliest failure on this work is a run that produces nothing; an edit that helps one rollout and risks emptiness elsewhere is a bad edit"; no evidence that any harness change would reduce variance or improve reliability; all runs succeeded in producing formatted answers.
</notes>

KEEP_BASE
